title: AMC 8 Practice: Pythagorean Theorem — The Ladder Over the Box
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on the length of a ladder leaning over a box, solved with rise over run and the Pythagorean theorem. (Level 5 of 5)
A ladder leans over a big box and touches the wall. How long is it?
Vantee shows how a ladder's steepness stays the same, how to find its height with rise over run, and how Pythagoras (and two friendly 3-4-5 triangles) gives the length.
